methods.what: Floor area as product of the two room dimensions in metres
Window recess area as product of width and depth, doubled for two windows, added to floor area
Conversion of square metres to square ells by subtracting twice the log of the ell length (log 0.58419 = 9.76655, doubled 9.53310)
Running length of carpet: area in square ells divided by width 1½ ells
